test_title: PYST 37: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held On: 13 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

One of the students is always / late to the class; he has been warn / by the teacher many times; / but still, he keeps on being late.

options.text: One of the students is always
but still, he keeps on being late
late to the class; he has been warn

solution:
The correct answer is **'late to the class; he has been warn'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here, '**late to the class; he has been warned**' should be used instead of '**late to the class; he has been warn**'.
 
• The corrected sentence uses the past participle form "**warned**" to indicate that the student has **already** received the warning from the teacher in the past.
 
• The **present perfect tense** is used to indicate that the warning occurred at an unspecified time in the past and may have continued up to the **present**.
 
• In contrast, the original sentence used the present tense form "**warn**" which is incorrect because it does not match the tense of the rest of the sentence.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *One of the students is always** __late to the class; he has been warned__** by the teacher many times; but still, he keeps on being late.*
